# cori.data.bfs

Access and analyze U.S. Census Bureau Business Formation Statistics
(BFS) at the county, state, and national level from 2005 to present.

## What’s in the package

Two variables, county + state + national, annual:

| Variable                | Description                             |
|-------------------------|-----------------------------------------|
| `business_applications` | Total business applications (BA series) |

Data are returned in long format: one row per `geoid / year / variable`.

| Geography | geoid format | Example   |
|-----------|--------------|-----------|
| County    | 5-digit FIPS | `"33009"` |
| State     | 2-digit FIPS | `"33"`    |
| National  | `"00"`       | `"00"`    |

## Installation

``` r

remotes::install_github("ruralinnovation/cori.data.bfs")
```

## Usage

``` r

library(cori.data.bfs)

# All data, latest vintage
df <- read_bfs_from_s3()

# Business applications for specific counties
df <- read_bfs_from_s3(
  variables = "business_applications",
  geoids    = c("54011", "54025"),
  years     = 2010:2024
)

# Variable documentation
get_bfs_codebook()
```

## Data source

**Census Bureau Business Formation Statistics** - Source file:
`https://www.census.gov/econ/bfs/xlsx/bfs_county_apps_annual.xlsx` -
Updated annually (~6 months after year-end) - Coverage: 2005–present

See
[RELEASE_CALENDAR.md](https://ruralinnovation.github.io/cori.data.bfs/RELEASE_CALENDAR.md)
for vintage log and update schedule.

## For CORI data engineers

To refresh the S3 data after Census releases new estimates:

``` r

write_bfs_processed_to_s3(years = 2005:2024)
```

# Package index

## Business Applications

- [`get_business_applications()`](https://ruralinnovation.github.io/cori.data.bfs/reference/get_business_applications.md)
  : Get Business Formation Statistics

## Utilities

- [`get_bfs_codebook()`](https://ruralinnovation.github.io/cori.data.bfs/reference/get_bfs_codebook.md)
  : Get the cori.data.bfs variable codebook
- [`read_bfs_from_s3()`](https://ruralinnovation.github.io/cori.data.bfs/reference/read_bfs_from_s3.md)
  **\[deprecated\]** : Read processed BFS data from S3

## Internal

Functions for data processing and maintenance

- [`pull_bfs()`](https://ruralinnovation.github.io/cori.data.bfs/reference/pull_bfs.md)
  : Pull Business Formation Statistics across multiple years
- [`write_bfs_processed_to_s3()`](https://ruralinnovation.github.io/cori.data.bfs/reference/write_bfs_processed_to_s3.md)
  : Write processed BFS data to S3 as a versioned vintage
